questions.question: Why should you bring copies of sources to class and not precious originals? What must you write on each one?
questions.expected_answer: Precious originals, such as the only family photograph, could get lost or damaged, so bring a copy or a photograph of them. On each one, write where it came from, such as the book, website, museum or person interviewed and the date.

questions.question: What does classify mean? Give two ways to classify information for a history project.
questions.expected_answer: Classify means to sort things into groups that belong together. You can sort information under your smaller questions, or by time, such as before the town, the early town and the town today.

questions.question: What makes good notes?
questions.expected_answer: Good notes are short points, not long sentences, in your own words, organised under headings, with the source written next to them.
